data.title: Candidate Dossier Retention and Talent Pool Transparency (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) & EDPB Guidelines 3/2019)
data.summary: Article 5(1)(e) of the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and European Data Protection Board Guidelines 3/2019 establish strict storage limitation principles for recruitment candidate data: holding candidate evaluation records in 'talent pool' pools beyond the initial hiring process requires explicit consent or legitimate interest bounded by stated expiration dates and transparent re-entry criteria.
data.citation: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 5(1)(e) ('kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed').
